war.name: Bullpen WAR
war.about: Our wins above replacement: batting, baserunning, fielding and pitching runs over a replacement-level player.

xwoba.name: Expected contact model (xwOBA+)
xwoba.about: Our expected wOBA from exit velocity, launch angle, hang time and sprint speed, plus walks and strikeouts, re-scored in a standard park.

stuff.name: Pitch models (Stuff+, Location+, Pitching+)
stuff.about: Our pitch-quality models: pitch quality from velocity, movement, spin, release and extension (Stuff+), from location (Location+) and both together (Pitching+); 100 = average.

framing.name: Catcher framing model
framing.about: Strikes a catcher adds over an average catcher on the same pitches, and the runs they are worth.

fielding.name: Fielding model (OAA per chance)
fielding.about: Outs above average per chance: plays made beyond what an average fielder makes on the same balls, and the runs they are worth.

decisions.name: Swing-decision model
decisions.about: The run value of a hitter's swing and take decisions per 100 pitches.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Runs per game better than average from offence, pitching and defence, from our game model.

xwoba_n: Expected wOBA from exit velocity, launch angle, hang time and sprint speed, plus walks and strikeouts, re-scored in a standard park.
woba: Weighted on-base average: every way of reaching base, weighted by the runs it is worth.
war_600: Bullpen WAR per 600 plate appearances: batting, baserunning, fielding and position in one number.
barrel_pct: Share of balls in play hit at the speed and angle that most often become extra-base hits.
hard_pct: Share of balls in play hit at 95 mph or harder.
bat_speed: Average speed of the bat's sweet spot on competitive swings (tracked since 2023).
chase_pct: How often the batter swings at pitches outside the strike zone.
sprint_speed: Top running speed on the fastest runs.
xwoba_plus: Expected wOBA from how the ball was hit, in the parks actually played in.
xwoba_savant: Statcast's expected wOBA from exit velocity and launch angle.
xslg: Statcast expected slugging from how the ball was hit.
iso: Isolated power: extra bases per at-bat.
ev: Average speed of balls in play.
ev90: 90th-percentile exit velocity: how hard the best contact is.
whiff_pct: Share of swings against the pitcher that miss.
z_swing_pct: Swings at pitches in the zone.
gb_pct: Ground balls per ball in play (style; fewer home runs).
pull_air_pct: Pulled line drives and fly balls per ball in play.
babip: Batting average on balls in play (mostly noise year to year).
dv100: Runs gained per 100 pitches by swing and take choices alone.
xwobacon_plus: xwOBA+ on balls in play only.
re24_pa: Run expectancy added per plate appearance.
sq_contact: Contact with 80 %+ of the attainable exit velocity.
swing_length: How far the bat head travels on each swing.
bsr: Runs from steals and taking extra bases (a total).
oaa: Outs above average over the season (a total).
sra: Outs above average per chance: how many more plays are made than an average fielder would on the same balls.
arm: Average speed of the hardest throws from the field.
framing_rate: Extra called strikes per called pitch received, against an average catcher on the same pitches, umpire and batter.
framing_runs: Runs saved by framing over the season (a total: depends on playing time).
framing_savant: Savant's catcher framing runs, for reference.
xfip: Fielding-independent pitching with home runs replaced by fly balls at the league rate (RA9 scale).
csw_pct: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.
stuff_plus: Pitch quality from velocity, movement, spin, release and extension alone.
pitching_plus: Stuff, location, count and sequencing together, per pitch.
fb_velo: Average speed of the primary fastball.
ra9: All runs allowed per nine innings (the result; noisy from year to year).
fip: Runs per nine from strikeouts, walks, hit batters and home runs only (RA9 scale).
k_bb_pct: Strikeout rate minus walk rate: the single best quick guide to a pitcher.
xra9: Expected runs per nine from xwOBA+ against.
location_plus: Value of where the ball is located, given count and pitch type.
fb_ivb: Induced vertical break of the fastball (rise against gravity).
fb_vaa: Vertical approach angle of the fastball at the plate.
extension: How far in front of the rubber the ball is released.
hr9: Home runs allowed per nine innings.
babip_against: Average on balls in play against the pitcher (mostly defence and luck).
tto_penalty: xwOBA the third time through the order minus the first.
fb_usage: Share of pitches that are fastballs.
br_usage: Share of pitches that are breaking balls.
os_usage: Share of pitches that are changeups or splitters.
war_x: Bullpen WAR from expected runs (a total).
gmli: Average leverage on entering the game (relievers; 1 = average).

rating: Expected run differential per game against an average team: offence + defence + pitching ratings.
baseruns_pct: The record the team's hits, walks and outs deserved, with the order they came in (sequencing luck) removed.
off_rpg: Batting plus baserunning runs above average per game.
pit_rpg: Runs saved per game by the pitchers, from the quality of contact, walks and strikeouts they allowed.
def_rpg: Fielding plus catcher framing runs per game.
bb_pct: The lineup's walks per plate appearance.
pythag: Win% expected from runs scored and allowed.
xwoba_savant: Statcast expected wOBA of the lineup.
xwoba_against: Statcast expected wOBA allowed by the staff.
p_k_bb: The staff's strikeout rate minus walk rate.
p_k_pct: The staff's strikeouts per batter faced.
k_pct: The lineup's strikeouts per plate appearance.
csw_pct: The staff's called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.
barrel_pct: The lineup's barrels per ball in play.
p_barrel_pct: Barrels allowed per ball in play.
